one_line: A mid-18th century Travancore state official overseeing land surveys, irrigation and agrarian revenues in Marthanda Varma’s kingdom.

appearance.age_look: Late 20s to mid-30s, lean but sturdy build, average height with a field-hardened presence.
appearance.face: Oval face with medium-brown Kerala complexion, sharp nose, neatly trimmed mustache, a small vertical sandalwood tilak on the forehead; default expression calm, observant and slightly serious, as if constantly assessing fields and accounts.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair tied back in a short, neat low bun at the nape, with a simple white cotton headcloth (small mundu-style turban) wrapped once around the head and knotted above the right ear, leaving the top flat and smooth.
appearance.costume: Era-accurate mid-18th century Travancore attire: an ankle-length off-white cotton mundu (wrap) with a narrow mustard-gold border and a slightly broader dark-green stripe near the hem, wrapped tightly at the waist and pleated in front; above, a long-sleeved, collarless light-cream cotton angarkha-style upper cloth that overlaps and ties at the right side, reaching mid-thigh; over his left shoulder and across the chest a soft, thinner off-white cotton shawl (veshti-style upper cloth) with the same mustard-gold border, used both as a symbol of office and to shield from sun; bare feet in simple dark-brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery: a thin gold chain around the neck, a narrow copper bangle on the right wrist, and small plain gold ear-studs; at his waist a dark-brown leather belt with two small cloth pouches for coins and seals, and a simple palm-leaf tally cord hanging from one side.
appearance.signature: A rolled palm-leaf survey bundle tied with red cotton cord, with a thin bamboo stylus tucked through the cord and a small wooden measuring rod (about forearm length) held in his other hand.

ref_desc: A lean, medium-brown Travancore revenue officer with an oval face, black hair in a low bun under a simple white headcloth, wearing an off-white mundu with mustard-gold and dark-green border, cream angarkha and shawl, carrying a tied palm-leaf survey bundle with bamboo stylus and a small wooden measuring rod in off-white, mustard-gold, dark green and dark brown tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a mid-18th century Travancore revenue officer standing in a neutral pose: he is a lean, medium-brown man with an oval face, sharp nose, neat mustache and calm, observant expression, black hair tied in a low bun under a simple white cotton headcloth wrapped once and knotted above the right ear; he wears an ankle-length off-white cotton mundu with a narrow mustard-gold border and a slightly broader dark-green stripe at the hem, a long-sleeved collarless light-cream angarkha-style upper garment overlapping and tied at the right side down to mid-thigh, and a matching off-white cotton shawl with mustard-gold border draped from his left shoulder across the chest; his feet are in simple dark-brown leather sandals, and he has a thin gold chain, a copper bangle on the right wrist and small plain gold ear-studs; a dark-brown leather belt holds two small cloth pouches and a palm-leaf tally cord; in his hands he carries his signature tools, a rolled palm-leaf survey bundle tied with red cord with a bamboo stylus tucked through it and a small wooden measuring rod about forearm length; show the character from multiple angles and a close-up of the face, keeping the off-white, mustard-gold, dark green, dark brown and soft cream colour palette consistent throughout.
